Josh Hazlewood to Anrich Nortje, no run, short of a good length and angling into the right-hander, Nortje looks to flick and gets an inside edge to FSL
Josh Hazlewood to Anrich Nortje, FOUR, width on offer and Nortje throws his hands on the back-foot drive, gets a thick edge that went flying past the slip cordon, off the mark with a boundary

Josh Hazlewood to Anrich Nortje, out Caught by Lyon!! 6 wickets for Hazlewood and Australia go 1-0 up with a 214-run thumping victory. Banged in short and at the right-hander, Nortje had no room on the pull, hit high on the bat and lobbed up towards mid-wicket - Lyon runs in and completes a simple catch.
